<output>
# ascii-image-converter

ascii-image-converter is a command-line tool that converts images into ASCII art and prints them to the console. It supports common image formats and provides options for colored output, braille art, saving output to files, and more.

Supported input formats:
- JPEG/JPG
- PNG
- BMP
- WEBP
- TIFF/TIF
- GIF

Basic CLI usage:

    ascii-image-converter [image paths/urls]

Example:

    ascii-image-converter myImage.jpeg

Common flags (summary):
- -C, --color        : Display ASCII art with colors from the original image
- -b, --braille       : Use braille characters instead of ASCII
- --threshold         : Threshold value for braille conversion (0-255)
- --dither            : Apply dithering for braille output
- -d, --dimensions    : Set width,height in characters (e.g. -d 60,30)
- -W, --width         : Set output width in characters
- -H, --height        : Set output height in characters
- -m, --map           : Provide a custom character map (darkest -> lightest)
- -g, --grayscale     : Output in grayscale
- -n, --negative      : Output in negative colors
- -c, --complex       : Use a more complex character set for detail
- -f, --full          : Fit output to terminal width while maintaining aspect ratio
- -s, --save-img      : Save ASCII art as a PNG image
- --save-txt          : Save ASCII art as a TXT file
- --save-gif          : Save GIFs as ASCII art GIFs (experimental)
- --font              : Path to .ttf font when saving images/gifs
- --font-color        : RGB value for font color when saving
- --save-bg           : RGBA background color when saving
- --formats           : Display supported input formats

Notes:
- Braille and color output depend on terminal/font support.
- GIF conversion/support may be limited for some GIFs.

For license information, see LICENSE or LICENSE.txt in the repository.
</output>

    [ORIGINAL, "/tmp/gradient10.png", "-s", "/tmp", "--save-bg", "300,0,0,100"],
    [ORIGINAL, "/tmp/gradient10.png", "-s", "/tmp", "--save-bg", "255,0,0,101"],
    [ORIGINAL, "/tmp/gradient10.png", "--font-color", "255,255"],
    [ORIGINAL, "/tmp/gradient10.png", "--font-color", "300,0,0"],
    [ORIGINAL, "/tmp/gradient10.png", "-s", "/tmp", "--font", "/nonexistent.ttf"],
    [ORIGINAL, "/tmp/gradient10.png", "-s", "/nonexistent_dir/foo", "-d", "10,10"],
]

passed = 0
failed = 0

for cmd in test_commands:
    cmd_orig = [cmd[0]] + cmd[1:]
    cmd_reb = [REBUILT] + cmd[1:]

    p_orig = subprocess.run(cmd_orig, capture_output=True, text=True)
    p_reb = subprocess.run(cmd_reb, capture_output=True, text=True)

    out_orig = p_orig.stdout
    out_reb = p_reb.stdout
    err_orig = p_orig.stderr
    err_reb = p_reb.stderr

    if out_orig == out_reb and err_orig == err_reb and p_orig.returncode == p_reb.returncode:
        passed += 1
    else:
        failed += 1
        print(f"FAILED test: {' '.join(cmd[1:])}")
        if out_orig != out_reb:
            print("STDOUT diff:")
            print("ORIGINAL:")
            print(repr(out_orig))
            print("REBUILT:")
            print(repr(out_reb))
        if err_orig != err_reb:
            print("STDERR diff:")
            print("ORIGINAL:", repr(err_orig))
            print("REBUILT:", repr(err_reb))
        if p_orig.returncode != p_reb.returncode:
            print(f"RETURNCODE diff: orig={p_orig.returncode}, reb={p_reb.returncode}")
        print("-" * 50)

print(f"Summary: {passed} passed, {failed} failed out of {len(test_commands)} tests.")
EOF
python3 /tmp/compare_tests.py"}

package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"image"
	_ "image/png"
	"os"

	"github.com/TheZoraiz/ascii-image-converter/resize"
)

func main() {
	f, _ := os.Open("/tmp/gradient10.png")
	srcImg, _, _ := image.Decode(f)
	f.Close()

	img := resize.Resize(20, 40, srcImg)

	dotMap := [4][2]rune{
		{0x01, 0x08},
		{0x02, 0x10},
		{0x04, 0x20},
		{0x40, 0x80},
	}
	wx, hy := 9, 0
	var bitmask rune
	for dy := 0; dy < 4; dy++ {
		for dx := 0; dx < 2; dx++ {
			px := wx*2 + dx
			py := hy*4 + dy
			c := img.RGBAAt(px, py)
			lum := 0.299*float64(c.R) + 0.587*float64(c.G) + 0.114*float64(c.B)
			on := lum >= 128.0
			if on {
				bitmask |= dotMap[dy][dx]
			}
			fmt.Printf("dx=%d, dy=%d (px=%d, py=%d): R=%d G=%d B=%d lum=%.2f -> ON=%v (dot=0x%02X)\n",
				dx, dy, px, py, c.R, c.G, c.B, lum, on, dotMap[dy][dx])
		}
	}
	r := rune(0x2800 + bitmask)
	fmt.Printf("Final rune: U+%04X %s\n", r, string(r))
}
EOF

actions.command:
cat <<'EOF' > cmd/root.go
package cmd

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"

	"github.com/TheZoraiz/ascii-image-converter/convert"
	"github.com/spf13/cobra"
)

var (
	opts convert.Options

	showFormats bool
	showVersion bool
)

var footerText = `Copyright © 2021 Zoraiz Hassan <hzoraiz8@gmail.com>
Distributed under the Apache License Version 2.0 (Apache-2.0)
For further details, visit https://github.com/TheZoraiz/ascii-image-converter
`

var rootCmd = &cobra.Command{
	Use:   "ascii-image-converter [image paths/urls or piped stdin]",
	Short: "This tool converts images into ascii art and prints them on the terminal.\nFurther configuration can be managed with flags.",
	Long:  "This tool converts images into ascii art and prints them on the terminal.\nFurther configuration can be managed with flags.",
	RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
		if showVersion {
			fmt.Println("v1.13.1")
			return nil
		}

		if showFormats {
			fmt.Println("Supported input formats:\n\nJPEG/JPG\nPNG\nWEBP\nBMP\nTIFF/TIF\nGIF\n")
			return nil
		}

		if len(args) == 0 {
			fmt.Print("Error: Need at least 1 input path/url or piped input\nUse the -h flag for more info\n\n")
			return nil
		}

		if err := convert.ValidateOptions(&opts); err != nil {
			fmt.Printf("Error: %v\n\n", err)
			return nil
		}

		for _, arg := range args {
			if err := convert.ProcessImage(arg, &opts); err != nil {
				fmt.Printf("Error: %v\n\n", err)
			}
		}

		return nil
	},
}

func Execute() {
	if err := rootCmd.Execute(); err != nil {
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}

func init() {
	rootCmd.SilenceUsage = true
	rootCmd.SilenceErrors = true

	rootCmd.SetFlagErrorFunc(func(c *cobra.Command, err error) error {
		c.Println(err)
		c.PrintErrf("Error: %v\nUsage:\n  %s\n\nFlags:\n%s\n%s\n", err, c.Use, c.Flags().FlagUsages(), footerText)
		return err
	})

	flags := rootCmd.Flags()
	flags.SortFlags = false

	flags.BoolVarP(&opts.Color, "color", "C", false, "Display ascii art with original colors\nIf 24-bit colors aren't supported, uses 8-bit\n(Inverts with --negative flag)\n(Overrides --grayscale and --font-color flags)\n")
	flags.BoolVar(&opts.ColorBg, "color-bg", false, "If some color flag is passed, use that color\non character background instead of foreground\n(Inverts with --negative flag)\n(Only applicable for terminal display)\n")
	flags.IntSliceVarP(&opts.Dimensions, "dimensions", "d", []int{}, "Set width and height for ascii art in CHARACTER length\ne.g. -d 60,30 (defaults to terminal height)\n(Overrides --width and --height flags)\n")
	flags.IntVarP(&opts.Width, "width", "W", 0, "Set width for ascii art in CHARACTER length\nHeight is kept to aspect ratio\ne.g. -W 60\n")
	flags.IntVarP(&opts.Height, "height", "H", 0, "Set height for ascii art in CHARACTER length\nWidth is kept to aspect ratio\ne.g. -H 60\n")
	flags.StringVarP(&opts.Map, "map", "m", "", "Give custom ascii characters to map against\nOrdered from darkest to lightest\ne.g. -m \" .-+#@\" (Quotation marks excluded from map)\n(Overrides --complex flag)\n")
	flags.BoolVarP(&opts.Braille, "braille", "b", false, "Use braille characters instead of ascii\nTerminal must support braille patterns properly\n(Overrides --complex and --map flags)\n")
	flags.IntVar(&opts.Threshold, "threshold", 128, "Threshold for braille art\nValue between 0-255 is accepted\ne.g. --threshold 170\n(Defaults to 128)\n")
	flags.BoolVar(&opts.Dither, "dither", false, "Apply dithering on image for braille\nart conversion\n(Only applicable with --braille flag)\n(Negates --threshold flag)\n")
	flags.BoolVarP(&opts.Grayscale, "grayscale", "g", false, "Display grayscale ascii art\n(Inverts with --negative flag)\n(Overrides --font-color flag)\n")
	flags.BoolVarP(&opts.Complex, "complex", "c", false, "Display ascii characters in a larger range\nMay result in higher quality\n")
	flags.BoolVarP(&opts.Full, "full", "f", false, "Use largest dimensions for ascii art\nthat fill the terminal width\n(Overrides --dimensions, --width and --height flags)\n")
	flags.BoolVarP(&opts.Negative, "negative", "n", false, "Display ascii art in negative colors\n")
	flags.BoolVarP(&opts.FlipX, "flipX", "x", false, "Flip ascii art horizontally\n")
	flags.BoolVarP(&opts.FlipY, "flipY", "y", false, "Flip ascii art vertically\n")
	flags.StringVarP(&opts.SaveImgPath, "save-img", "s", "", "Save ascii art as a .png file\nFormat: <image-name>-ascii-art.png\nImage will be saved in passed path\n(pass . for current directory)\n")
	flags.StringVar(&opts.SaveTxtPath, "save-txt", "", "Save ascii art as a .txt file\nFormat: <image-name>-ascii-art.txt\nFile will be saved in passed path\n(pass . for current directory)\n")
	flags.StringVar(&opts.SaveGifPath, "save-gif", "", "If input is a gif, save it as a .gif file\nFormat: <gif-name>-ascii-art.gif\nGif will be saved in passed path\n(pass . for current directory)\n")
	flags.IntSliceVar(&opts.SaveBg, "save-bg", []int{0, 0, 0, 100}, "Set background color for --save-img\nand --save-gif flags\nPass an RGBA value\ne.g. --save-bg 255,255,255,100\n(Defaults to 0,0,0,100)\n")
	flags.StringVar(&opts.Font, "font", "", "Set font for --save-img and --save-gif flags\nPass file path to font .ttf file\ne.g. --font ./RobotoMono-Regular.ttf\n(Defaults to Hack-Regular for ascii and\n DejaVuSans-Oblique for braille)\n")
	flags.IntSliceVar(&opts.FontColor, "font-color", []int{255, 255, 255}, "Set font color for terminal as well as\n--save-img and --save-gif flags\nPass an RGB value\ne.g. --font-color 0,0,0\n(Defaults to 255,255,255)\n")
	flags.BoolVar(&opts.OnlySave, "only-save", false, "Don't print ascii art on terminal\nif some saving flag is passed\n")
	flags.BoolVar(&showFormats, "formats", false, "Display supported input formats\n")
	flags.BoolVarP(&showVersion, "version", "v", false, "Version for ascii-image-converter\n")

	rootCmd.SetHelpTemplate(`This tool converts images into ascii art and prints them on the terminal.
Further configuration can be managed with flags.

Usage:
  ascii-image-converter [image paths/urls or piped stdin] [flags]

Flags:
{{.Flags.FlagUsages | trimTrailingWhitespaces}}

Copyright © 2021 Zoraiz Hassan <hzoraiz8@gmail.com>
Distributed under the Apache License Version 2.0 (Apache-2.0)
For further details, visit https://github.com/TheZoraiz/ascii-image-converter
`)
}
EOF

actions.command:
cat <<'EOF' > cmd/root.go
package cmd

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"

	"github.com/TheZoraiz/ascii-image-converter/convert"
	"github.com/spf13/cobra"
)

var (
	opts convert.Options

	showFormats bool
	showVersion bool
)

var footerText = `Copyright © 2021 Zoraiz Hassan <hzoraiz8@gmail.com>
Distributed under the Apache License Version 2.0 (Apache-2.0)
For further details, visit https://github.com/TheZoraiz/ascii-image-converter
`

var rootCmd = &cobra.Command{
	Use:   "ascii-image-converter [image paths/urls or piped stdin]",
	Short: "This tool converts images into ascii art and prints them on the terminal.\nFurther configuration can be managed with flags.",
	Long:  "This tool converts images into ascii art and prints them on the terminal.\nFurther configuration can be managed with flags.",
	RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
		if showVersion {
			fmt.Println("v1.13.1")
			return nil
		}

		if showFormats {
			fmt.Println("Supported input formats:\n\nJPEG/JPG\nPNG\nWEBP\nBMP\nTIFF/TIF\nGIF\n")
			return nil
		}

		if len(args) == 0 {
			fmt.Print("Error: Need at least 1 input path/url or piped input\nUse the -h flag for more info\n\n")
			return nil
		}

		if err := convert.ValidateOptions(&opts); err != nil {
			fmt.Printf("Error: %v\n\n", err)
			return nil
		}

		for _, arg := range args {
			if err := convert.ProcessImage(arg, &opts); err != nil {
				fmt.Printf("Error: %v\n\n", err)
			}
		}

		return nil
	},
}

func Execute() {
	if err := rootCmd.Execute(); err != nil {
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}

func init() {
	rootCmd.SetOut(os.Stdout)
	rootCmd.SetErr(os.Stderr)

	rootCmd.SilenceUsage = true
	rootCmd.SilenceErrors = true

	rootCmd.SetFlagErrorFunc(func(c *cobra.Command, err error) error {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stdout, err)
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Error: %v\nUsage:\n  %s\n\nFlags:\n%s\n%s\n", err, c.Use, c.Flags().FlagUsages(), footerText)
		return err
	})

	flags := rootCmd.Flags()
	flags.SortFlags = false

	flags.BoolVarP(&opts.Color, "color", "C", false, "Display ascii art with original colors\nIf 24-bit colors aren't supported, uses 8-bit\n(Inverts with --negative flag)\n(Overrides --grayscale and --font-color flags)\n")
	flags.BoolVar(&opts.ColorBg, "color-bg", false, "If some color flag is passed, use that color\non character background instead of foreground\n(Inverts with --negative flag)\n(Only applicable for terminal display)\n")
	flags.IntSliceVarP(&opts.Dimensions, "dimensions", "d", []int{}, "Set width and height for ascii art in CHARACTER length\ne.g. -d 60,30 (defaults to terminal height)\n(Overrides --width and --height flags)\n")
	flags.IntVarP(&opts.Width, "width", "W", 0, "Set width for ascii art in CHARACTER length\nHeight is kept to aspect ratio\ne.g. -W 60\n")
	flags.IntVarP(&opts.Height, "height", "H", 0, "Set height for ascii art in CHARACTER length\nWidth is kept to aspect ratio\ne.g. -H 60\n")
	flags.StringVarP(&opts.Map, "map", "m", "", "Give custom ascii characters to map against\nOrdered from darkest to lightest\ne.g. -m \" .-+#@\" (Quotation marks excluded from map)\n(Overrides --complex flag)\n")
	flags.BoolVarP(&opts.Braille, "braille", "b", false, "Use braille characters instead of ascii\nTerminal must support braille patterns properly\n(Overrides --complex and --map flags)\n")
	flags.IntVar(&opts.Threshold, "threshold", 128, "Threshold for braille art\nValue between 0-255 is accepted\ne.g. --threshold 170\n(Defaults to 128)\n")
	flags.BoolVar(&opts.Dither, "dither", false, "Apply dithering on image for braille\nart conversion\n(Only applicable with --braille flag)\n(Negates --threshold flag)\n")
	flags.BoolVarP(&opts.Grayscale, "grayscale", "g", false, "Display grayscale ascii art\n(Inverts with --negative flag)\n(Overrides --font-color flag)\n")
	flags.BoolVarP(&opts.Complex, "complex", "c", false, "Display ascii characters in a larger range\nMay result in higher quality\n")
	flags.BoolVarP(&opts.Full, "full", "f", false, "Use largest dimensions for ascii art\nthat fill the terminal width\n(Overrides --dimensions, --width and --height flags)\n")
	flags.BoolVarP(&opts.Negative, "negative", "n", false, "Display ascii art in negative colors\n")
	flags.BoolVarP(&opts.FlipX, "flipX", "x", false, "Flip ascii art horizontally\n")
	flags.BoolVarP(&opts.FlipY, "flipY", "y", false, "Flip ascii art vertically\n")
	flags.StringVarP(&opts.SaveImgPath, "save-img", "s", "", "Save ascii art as a .png file\nFormat: <image-name>-ascii-art.png\nImage will be saved in passed path\n(pass . for current directory)\n")
	flags.StringVar(&opts.SaveTxtPath, "save-txt", "", "Save ascii art as a .txt file\nFormat: <image-name>-ascii-art.txt\nFile will be saved in passed path\n(pass . for current directory)\n")
	flags.StringVar(&opts.SaveGifPath, "save-gif", "", "If input is a gif, save it as a .gif file\nFormat: <gif-name>-ascii-art.gif\nGif will be saved in passed path\n(pass . for current directory)\n")
	flags.IntSliceVar(&opts.SaveBg, "save-bg", []int{0, 0, 0, 100}, "Set background color for --save-img\nand --save-gif flags\nPass an RGBA value\ne.g. --save-bg 255,255,255,100\n(Defaults to 0,0,0,100)\n")
	flags.StringVar(&opts.Font, "font", "", "Set font for --save-img and --save-gif flags\nPass file path to font .ttf file\ne.g. --font ./RobotoMono-Regular.ttf\n(Defaults to Hack-Regular for ascii and\n DejaVuSans-Oblique for braille)\n")
	flags.IntSliceVar(&opts.FontColor, "font-color", []int{255, 255, 255}, "Set font color for terminal as well as\n--save-img and --save-gif flags\nPass an RGB value\ne.g. --font-color 0,0,0\n(Defaults to 255,255,255)\n")
	flags.BoolVar(&opts.OnlySave, "only-save", false, "Don't print ascii art on terminal\nif some saving flag is passed\n")
	flags.BoolVar(&showFormats, "formats", false, "Display supported input formats\n")
	flags.BoolVarP(&showVersion, "version", "v", false, "Version for ascii-image-converter\n")

	rootCmd.SetHelpTemplate(`This tool converts images into ascii art and prints them on the terminal.
Further configuration can be managed with flags.

Usage:
  ascii-image-converter [image paths/urls or piped stdin] [flags]

Flags:
{{.Flags.FlagUsages | trimTrailingWhitespaces}}

Copyright © 2021 Zoraiz Hassan <hzoraiz8@gmail.com>
Distributed under the Apache License Version 2.0 (Apache-2.0)
For further details, visit https://github.com/TheZoraiz/ascii-image-converter
`)
}
EOF

{"command":"cat <<'EOF' > cmd/root.go
package cmd

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"regexp"

	"github.com/TheZoraiz/ascii-image-converter/convert"
	"github.com/spf13/cobra"
)

var (
	opts convert.Options

	showFormats bool
	showVersion bool
	defaultRegex = regexp.MustCompile(` \(default [^)]*\)`)
)

var footerText = `Copyright © 2021 Zoraiz Hassan <hzoraiz8@gmail.com>
Distributed under the Apache License Version 2.0 (Apache-2.0)
For further details, visit https://github.com/TheZoraiz/ascii-image-converter
`

var rootCmd = &cobra.Command{
	Use:   "ascii-image-converter [image paths/urls or piped stdin]",
	Short: "This tool converts images into ascii art and prints them on the terminal.\nFurther configuration can be managed with flags.",
	Long:  "This tool converts images into ascii art and prints them on the terminal.\nFurther configuration can be managed with flags.",
	RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
		if showVersion {
			fmt.Println("v1.13.1")
			return nil
		}

		if showFormats {
			fmt.Println("Supported input formats:\n\nJPEG/JPG\nPNG\nWEBP\nBMP\nTIFF/TIF\nGIF\n")
			return nil
		}

		if len(args) == 0 {
			fmt.Print("Error: Need at least 1 input path/url or piped input\nUse the -h flag for more info\n\n")
			return nil
		}

		if err := convert.ValidateOptions(&opts); err != nil {
			fmt.Printf("Error: %v\n\n", err)
			return nil
		}

		for _, arg := range args {
			if err := convert.ProcessImage(arg, &opts); err != nil {
				fmt.Printf("Error: %v\n\n", err)
			}
		}

		return nil
	},
}

func Execute() {
	if err := rootCmd.Execute(); err != nil {
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}

func init() {
	rootCmd.SetOut(os.Stdout)
	rootCmd.SetErr(os.Stderr)

	rootCmd.SilenceUsage = true
	rootCmd.SilenceErrors = true

	rootCmd.SetFlagErrorFunc(func(c *cobra.Command, err error) error {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stdout, err)
		cleanUsages := defaultRegex.ReplaceAllString(c.Flags().FlagUsages(), "")
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Error: %v\nUsage:\n  %s\n\nFlags:\n%s\n%s\n", err, c.Use, cleanUsages, footerText)
		return err
	})

	flags := rootCmd.Flags()
	flags.SortFlags = false

	flags.BoolVarP(&opts.Color, "color", "C", false, "Display ascii art with original colors\nIf 24-bit colors aren't supported, uses 8-bit\n(Inverts with --negative flag)\n(Overrides --grayscale and --font-color flags)\n")
	flags.BoolVar(&opts.ColorBg, "color-bg", false, "If some color flag is passed, use that color\non character background instead of foreground\n(Inverts with --negative flag)\n(Only applicable for terminal display)\n")
	flags.IntSliceVarP(&opts.Dimensions, "dimensions", "d", []int{}, "Set width and height for ascii art in CHARACTER length\ne.g. -d 60,30 (defaults to terminal height)\n(Overrides --width and --height flags)\n")
	flags.IntVarP(&opts.Width, "width", "W", 0, "Set width for ascii art in CHARACTER length\nHeight is kept to aspect ratio\ne.g. -W 60\n")
	flags.IntVarP(&opts.Height, "height", "H", 0, "Set height for ascii art in CHARACTER length\nWidth is kept to aspect ratio\ne.g. -H 60\n")
	flags.StringVarP(&opts.Map, "map", "m", "", "Give custom ascii characters to map against\nOrdered from darkest to lightest\ne.g. -m \" .-+#@\" (Quotation marks excluded from map)\n(Overrides --complex flag)\n")
	flags.BoolVarP(&opts.Braille, "braille", "b", false, "Use braille characters instead of ascii\nTerminal must support braille patterns properly\n(Overrides --complex and --map flags)\n")
	flags.IntVar(&opts.Threshold, "threshold", 128, "Threshold for braille art\nValue between 0-255 is accepted\ne.g. --threshold 170\n(Defaults to 128)\n")
	flags.BoolVar(&opts.Dither, "dither", false, "Apply dithering on image for braille\nart conversion\n(Only applicable with --braille flag)\n(Negates --threshold flag)\n")
	flags.BoolVarP(&opts.Grayscale, "grayscale", "g", false, "Display grayscale ascii art\n(Inverts with --negative flag)\n(Overrides --font-color flag)\n")
	flags.BoolVarP(&opts.Complex, "complex", "c", false, "Display ascii characters in a larger range\nMay result in higher quality\n")
	flags.BoolVarP(&opts.Full, "full", "f", false, "Use largest dimensions for ascii art\nthat fill the terminal width\n(Overrides --dimensions, --width and --height flags)\n")

	"github.com/spf13/cobra"

			fmt.Println("Supported input formats:\n\nJPEG/JPG\nPNG\nWEBP\nBMP\nTIFF/TIF\nGIF\n")

			fmt.Print("Error: Need at least 1 input path/url or piped input\nUse the -h flag for more info\n\n")

package cmd

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"regexp"

	"github.com/TheZoraiz/ascii-image-converter/convert"
	"github.com/spf13/cobra"
)

var (
	opts convert.Options

	showFormats bool
	showVersion bool
	defaultRegex = regexp.MustCompile(` \(default [^)]*\)`)
)

var footerText = `Copyright © 2021 Zoraiz Hassan <hzoraiz8@gmail.com>
Distributed under the Apache License Version 2.0 (Apache-2.0)
For further details, visit https://github.com/TheZoraiz/ascii-image-converter
`

var rootCmd = &cobra.Command{
	Use:   "ascii-image-converter [image paths/urls or piped stdin]",
	Short: "This tool converts images into ascii art and prints them on the terminal.\nFurther configuration can be managed with flags.",
	Long:  "This tool converts images into ascii art and prints them on the terminal.\nFurther configuration can be managed with flags.",
	RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
		if showVersion {
			fmt.Println("v1.13.1")
			return nil
		}

		if showFormats {
			fmt.Println("Supported input formats:\n\nJPEG/JPG\nPNG\nWEBP\nBMP\nTIFF/TIF\nGIF\n")
			return nil
		}

		if len(args) == 0 {
			fmt.Print("Error: Need at least 1 input path/url or piped input\nUse the -h flag for more info\n\n")
			return nil
		}

		if err := convert.ValidateOptions(&opts); err != nil {
			fmt.Printf("Error: %v\n\n", err)
			return nil
		}

		for _, arg := range args {
			if err := convert.ProcessImage(arg, &opts); err != nil {
				fmt.Printf("Error: %v\n\n", err)
			}
		}

		return nil
	},
}

func Execute() {
	if err := rootCmd.Execute(); err != nil {
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}

	rootCmd.SetOut(os.Stdout)
	rootCmd.SetErr(os.Stderr)

	rootCmd.SilenceErrors = true

		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stdout, err)
		cleanUsages := defaultRegex.ReplaceAllString(c.Flags().FlagUsages(), "")
